 Company. Porsche AG: Driving Between Luxury and Premium 
 
 Company. Porsche AG: Driving Between Luxury and Premium Jul 31, 2024

 On this Company episode of The Synopsis we
cover Porsche AG. Porsche is a brand that has tried to become
"luxury at scale" with over 300k units produced annually versus
undisputed luxury car brands who produce closer to ~10k. While
their strategy might have diluted their brand, they still enjoy
superior positioning compared to most premium car manufacturs like
BMW and Mercedes-Benz. 

 Listen to this episiode to learn not just
about Porsche's history and business model, but also about the car
industry and different car manufacturer's strategies.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 In this podcast we share our insights from hundreds of hours of investment research and various topics Drew Cohen has covered on his YouTube Channel and Five Minute Money Newsletter. Drew Cohen is an investment manager, registered investment advisor, and founder of Speedwell Research, which produces in-depth research reports for hedge funds and asset managers.
